defs.def: an animal with horns and a coat of hair, that lives wild in mountain areas or is kept on farms for its milk or meat 山羊

ex.s: In addition to seeing spectacular mountain peaks and forests, one highlight of their trip was being able to see many different creatures, including deer, mountain goats, and even a grizzly bear and an eagle.
ex.t: 除了看到壮观的山峰和森林，他们旅途中的一个亮点是能看到许多不同的动物，包括鹿、山羊，甚至一只灰熊和一只鹰。

ex.s: If that looking glass gets broke, Papa’s gonna buy you a billy goat.
ex.t: 如果那面镜子碎了，爸爸给你买只山羊。

ex.s: If that billy goat won’t pull, Papa’s gonna buy you a cart and bull.
ex.t: 如果那只山羊不好好拉，爸爸给你买辆牛车。

ex.s: I fed cows, goats andchickens,andevenlearntto ridea horse.Youdon't needto visit museums,cinemas or community centres because you can explore forests,cavesandbeaches.Ididn't miss going online because I was too busy connecting with nature!
ex.t: 我喂了牛、山羊和鸡，甚至还学会了骑马。你不用去博物馆、电影院或社区中心，因为你可以探索森林、洞穴和海滩。我没有想念上网，因为我忙着与大自然连接！

defs.def: an unpleasant old man who is annoying in a sexual way 老色鬼；色狼；好色之徒
